photographs.name: DSC07520
photographs.title: 潮汐的形状
photographs.description: 澳大利亚海岸，浅色沙洲与蓝绿色海水交织。
photographs.descriptionEn: Pale sandbars meet turquoise water along the Australian coast.
photographs.note: 沙洲的浅色曲线把水面分成几种深浅。远处的山与近处的潮水叠在一起，辽阔的空间有了细小而缓慢的变化。
photographs.noteEn: Pale curves of sand divide the water into shades of depth. Distant hills meet the nearer tide, giving an expansive space a small, slow movement.

photographs.name: DSC02777
photographs.title: 街巷之间
photographs.description: 京都街巷中的屋顶、行人与远山。
photographs.descriptionEn: Rooftops, passersby and distant hills in Kyoto.
photographs.note: 屋顶层层向远山延伸，行人被留在街道的窄处。建筑与山的轮廓连在一起，目光沿着人群走入画面。
photographs.noteEn: Roofs extend towards the distant hills; people occupy the narrow street below. The outlines of buildings and mountains join, drawing the eye into the picture along the crowd.

photographs.name: DSC07749
photographs.title: 蓝色的纹理
photographs.description: 从高处俯瞰海水与礁石的纹理。
photographs.descriptionEn: Patterns of water and reef seen from above.
photographs.note: 礁石的纹理隔着海水显露出来。俯瞰让距离变得难以判断：海的深度，暂时成为一片颜色与线条。
photographs.noteEn: The reef shows through the water. From above, distance becomes difficult to judge: the depth of the sea briefly takes the form of colour and line.

photographs.name: DSC09617
photographs.title: 城市的缝隙
photographs.description: 香港街巷中，高楼之间的行人与道路。
photographs.descriptionEn: A street, pedestrians and tall buildings in Hong Kong.
photographs.note: 街道被高楼夹成一道细缝，人的身形因而显得很小。视线顺着建筑向下，最终落在仍然有人走过的路上。
photographs.noteEn: Tall buildings narrow the street to a seam and make the figures seem small. The eye follows the architecture down to a road where people continue to pass.

photographs.name: DSC04302
photographs.title: 渡船上的片刻
photographs.description: 曼谷渡船上，一位乘客望向河岸。
photographs.descriptionEn: A passenger looks towards the riverbank from a ferry in Bangkok.
photographs.note: 座椅、窗框与乘客的侧影，把流动的河岸围进一个安静的片刻。船在移动，画面却把目光留在了她身旁。
photographs.noteEn: Seats, a window frame and a passenger’s profile enclose the moving riverbank in a quiet moment. The boat is travelling, but the picture keeps our gaze beside her.

photographs.name: IMG_20240518_223126
photographs.title: 光里的身影
photographs.description: 室内展览空间中，三个人的剪影。
photographs.descriptionEn: Three silhouettes inside an exhibition space.
photographs.note: 亮处与暗处在墙面上分开，三个人的身影成为这道边界的尺度。人物之间的空隙，也像空间的一部分。
photographs.noteEn: Light and shade divide the wall; three figures give that boundary a human scale. The gaps between them become part of the space.

photographs.name: DSC00886
photographs.title: 林间的光
photographs.description: 南京林间，阳光穿过树木落在草地上。
photographs.descriptionEn: Sunlight falls through the trees onto grass in Nanjing.
photographs.note: 树影把草地分成明亮与幽暗的部分。细密的枝干在画面里重复，光从它们之间落下来。
photographs.noteEn: Shadows divide the grass into bright and dark areas. Slender branches repeat across the frame, with light falling between them.

photographs.name: DSC00272_1
photographs.title: 灶台前
photographs.description: 越南街头，一位厨师在灶台前烹饪。
photographs.descriptionEn: A cook at work beside a street-side stove in Vietnam.
photographs.note: 灶台与锅占据了前景，人的动作在器具之间展开。颜色、手势与狭窄的工作空间，构成这一刻的秩序。
photographs.noteEn: The stove and pan occupy the foreground, with a gesture unfolding among the utensils. Colour, movement and a narrow working space give this moment its order.

photographs.name: IMG_20240430_085311
photographs.title: 经过海面
photographs.description: 蓝绿色海面上，船只留下弧形的白色航迹。
photographs.descriptionEn: A boat leaves a curved white wake across turquoise water.
photographs.note: 船很小，身后的白色线条却向远处展开。水面保存了它刚刚经过的方向，航迹也成为画面里的时间刻度。
photographs.noteEn: The boat is small, but the white line behind it extends into the distance. The water holds the direction of its passage; the wake becomes a measure of time within the frame.

photographs.name: IMG_20240213_210927
photographs.title: 一束光
photographs.description: 澳门室内空间中的十字架、石块与天光。
photographs.descriptionEn: A cross, stone and daylight inside a space in Macau.
photographs.note: 天光沿墙面落下，十字架与石块留在暖色的暗处。简单的形状因明暗的分界而有了重量与距离。
photographs.noteEn: Daylight falls along the wall, while a cross and stones remain in warm shadow. A boundary between light and dark gives these simple forms weight and distance.

photographs.name: DSC09079
photographs.title: 朱红的秩序
photographs.description: 大阪，朱红色鸟居框出的神社入口。
photographs.descriptionEn: A vermilion torii frames a shrine entrance in Osaka.
photographs.note: 重复的朱红门框把视线推向庭院。进入与停留之间，只隔着一道明亮的边界。
photographs.noteEn: Repeating vermilion gates lead the eye towards the courtyard. A bright boundary separates entering from pausing.

photographs.name: IMG_20250308_232434
photographs.title: 雨落东京
photographs.description: 雨夜东京街头，灯光映照湿润的路面。
photographs.descriptionEn: Street lights reflect on the wet pavement in Tokyo at night.
photographs.note: 雨水让路面成为另一幅城市图像。灯牌与人的身影在上下两层空间里相遇，倒影很快又被脚步打断。
photographs.noteEn: Rain makes the road into another image of the city. Signs and figures meet above and below, their reflections interrupted by passing feet.

photographs.name: IMG_20250203_161907
photographs.title: 水边的静处
photographs.description: 厦门水面上的亭子与倒影。
photographs.descriptionEn: A pavilion and its reflection on the water in Xiamen.
photographs.note: 亭子与倒影在水面上下相接。岸边的树木围住这一小块空间，使目光暂时从远处回到水边。
photographs.noteEn: The pavilion meets its reflection across the water. Trees enclose this small space, bringing the eye back from a distance to the water’s edge.

photographs.name: DSC01813
photographs.title: 灰蓝的海
photographs.description: 济州岛海岸，岩石与海鸟。
photographs.descriptionEn: Rocks and seabirds along the coast of Jeju.
photographs.note: 浅水、石块与一只白色水鸟，把海岸的边缘分成细小的层次。海面没有明确的终点，近处却有一个安静的落脚处。
photographs.noteEn: Shallow water, stones and a white shorebird give the edge of the coast its small layers. The sea has no clear endpoint, while the foreground offers a quiet place to rest the eye.

photographs.name: DSC00109
photographs.title: 蒸汽前的细线
photographs.description: 大片白色蒸汽在蓝天下升起，深色地面上一列细小人物沿步道分布。
photographs.descriptionEn: A large plume of white steam rises into a blue sky, with small figures lining a walkway across dark ground.
photographs.alt: 大片白色蒸汽在蓝天下升起，深色地面上一列细小人物沿步道分布。
photographs.altEn: A large plume of white steam rises into a blue sky, with small figures lining a walkway across dark ground.
photographs.note: 蒸汽占满上方，人排成下方一道细线。画面中的尺度首先来自这一列身影，随后才是远处树木与地面的边缘。
photographs.noteEn: Steam fills the space above, while people form a fine line below. Their figures establish the scale before the distant trees and edges of the ground do.
photographs.decisionReason: 开场核心：身体尺度立即成立；同一蒸汽景观不再另收 DSC00103 或 DSC00337。

photographs.name: DSC00406
photographs.title: 橙色的孔隙
photographs.description: 橙色、黑色与灰白色地表交错，近处可见许多大小不一的深色孔洞与细碎纹理。
photographs.descriptionEn: Orange, black and pale grey surfaces meet in a close view of dark hollows and fine textures of varying sizes.
photographs.alt: 橙色、黑色与灰白色地表交错，近处可见许多大小不一的深色孔洞与细碎纹理。
photographs.altEn: Orange, black and pale grey surfaces meet in a close view of dark hollows and fine textures of varying sizes.
photographs.note: 这里没有地平线。橙色表面的孔洞、细枝与灰白区域把视线留在近处，开场的广阔空间被收回到一块表面。
photographs.noteEn: There is no horizon here. Hollows, small twigs and patches of pale grey hold the eye close, bringing the expansive opening back to a single surface.
photographs.decisionReason: 开场近图：近远转换；比 DSC00290 一般沉积全景更精确，不同收。

photographs.name: DSC00368
photographs.title: 石面转入水中
photographs.description: 带有橙色和灰白色条纹的弯曲石面贴近深蓝水面，边缘形成反复起伏的弧线。
photographs.descriptionEn: A curved stone surface striped with orange and pale grey meets deep blue water along repeated undulating edges.
photographs.alt: 带有橙色和灰白色条纹的弯曲石面贴近深蓝水面，边缘形成反复起伏的弧线。
photographs.altEn: A curved stone surface striped with orange and pale grey meets deep blue water along repeated undulating edges.
photographs.note: 石面的纹理沿着坡度向下延伸，到蓝色水边忽然终止。几道重复的弧线让边界有了厚度，平面也变得可以触摸。
photographs.noteEn: Stripes follow the slope of the stone and end abruptly at blue water. Repeated curves give the boundary thickness, making the surface feel tangible.
photographs.decisionReason: 第一章起点：纹理从平铺转向有体积的边界。

photographs.name: DSC07950
photographs.title: 成列的岩柱
photographs.description: 橙红色岩柱密集分布，横向层纹贯穿不同高度的石体，较远处有深色树林与山地。
photographs.descriptionEn: Dense orange-red rock columns of differing heights share horizontal layers, with dark woodland and hills farther away.
photographs.alt: 橙红色岩柱密集分布，横向层纹贯穿不同高度的石体，较远处有深色树林与山地。
photographs.altEn: Dense orange-red rock columns of differing heights share horizontal layers, with dark woodland and hills farther away.
photographs.note: 横向的层纹经过一根根竖直岩柱，近处和远处的石体挤在一起。高低差与密度让地面从一片表面变成许多断面。
photographs.noteEn: Horizontal layers pass through upright columns, crowding near and distant forms together. Height and density turn one surface into many faces.
photographs.decisionReason: 第一章体量：保留层理/密度关系而不是特定景点说明。

photographs.name: DSC08017
photographs.title: 高岩与飞鸟
photographs.description: 浅橙色岩壁从右侧伸向蓝天，一只黑色飞鸟位于岩尖旁，天空中有薄云。
photographs.descriptionEn: Pale orange rock rises at the right against a blue sky, with a dark bird beside a pinnacle and thin clouds beyond.
photographs.alt: 浅橙色岩壁从右侧伸向蓝天，一只黑色飞鸟位于岩尖旁，天空中有薄云。
photographs.altEn: Pale orange rock rises at the right against a blue sky, with a dark bird beside a pinnacle and thin clouds beyond.
photographs.note: 从向下俯看的石面转到向上望，岩壁的纹理仍然清楚。一只飞鸟把高处的空隙变成很小的一次经过。
photographs.noteEn: The view turns from looking down at a surface to looking up, with the rock texture still clear. A bird briefly marks the small gap high above.
photographs.decisionReason: 改变角度核心：避免全展都为俯瞰地貌；飞鸟作为尺度，不猜测种类。

photographs.name: DSC01409_1
photographs.title: 岩岸的空隙
photographs.description: 浅色尖状礁石从蓝绿色海水中伸出，岩石之间有窄水道，底部边缘附有深色带状物。
photographs.descriptionEn: Pale pointed rocks rise from blue-green sea water, with narrow channels between them and dark bands along their lower edges.
photographs.alt: 浅色尖状礁石从蓝绿色海水中伸出，岩石之间有窄水道，底部边缘附有深色带状物。
photographs.altEn: Pale pointed rocks rise from blue-green sea water, with narrow channels between them and dark bands along their lower edges.
photographs.note: 石体的竖向纹理与水面的细波紧贴在一起。岩岸没有完整的外轮廓，水从许多缝隙之间进入画面。
photographs.noteEn: Vertical rock textures sit closely against small ripples. The shore has no single outline: water enters through many gaps.
photographs.decisionReason: 第一章由石到水：唯一竖幅礁岸近图，不另收 Busan/DSC00878 相似海边石景。

photographs.name: DSC07554
photographs.title: 岩壁间的折返
photographs.description: 红色岩壁与绿色灌木之间，一条浅色小径反复折返，路径上可见细小人物。
photographs.descriptionEn: A pale path makes repeated switchbacks between red rock walls and green shrubs, with tiny figures along it.
photographs.alt: 红色岩壁与绿色灌木之间，一条浅色小径反复折返，路径上可见细小人物。
photographs.altEn: A pale path makes repeated switchbacks between red rock walls and green shrubs, with tiny figures along it.
photographs.note: 一道浅线在石壁之间转弯，宽度远小于周围的岩块。走在其中的人进一步说明，画面里的折返不只是一种图案。
photographs.noteEn: A pale line bends between rock walls, far narrower than the surrounding stone. Small walkers show that these turns are more than a pattern.
photographs.decisionReason: 第二章小尺度步径：人的行走与线的形状相连，非按照地名排照片。

photographs.name: DSC08079
photographs.title: 峡谷里的弯路
photographs.description: 巨大的红色岩壁围绕低处一段弯曲公路，路上有一辆浅色汽车，周围散布低矮植被。
photographs.descriptionEn: Tall red rock walls surround a curved stretch of road below, with a pale car and low vegetation scattered nearby.
photographs.alt: 巨大的红色岩壁围绕低处一段弯曲公路，路上有一辆浅色汽车，周围散布低矮植被。
photographs.altEn: Tall red rock walls surround a curved stretch of road below, with a pale car and low vegetation scattered nearby.
photographs.note: 公路在低处留下一段清楚的弯曲，巨大的岩壁却占据了更多空间。车辆足够小，路的宽度也被重新读出来。
photographs.noteEn: The road makes a clear bend low in the frame, while the rock walls occupy much more space. The small car allows its width to be read anew.
photographs.decisionReason: 第二章扩大环境：与 DSC07554 不是同尺寸重复，步道到车道再到巨大断面；不另收一般路面 DSC08060_1。

photographs.name: IMG_20251001_215956
photographs.title: 水边的双线
photographs.description: 一段有双白线的弯曲公路经过粉红色水面，两辆深色汽车在路上，远处是低矮丘陵与蓝天。
photographs.descriptionEn: A curved road with double white lines passes pink water, carrying two dark cars beneath low hills and a blue sky.
photographs.alt: 一段有双白线的弯曲公路经过粉红色水面，两辆深色汽车在路上，远处是低矮丘陵与蓝天。
photographs.altEn: A curved road with double white lines passes pink water, carrying two dark cars beneath low hills and a blue sky.
photographs.note: 白色双线紧贴着弯路，水面在它的另一侧大面积铺开。路将人带到边缘，也把两种颜色暂时分在两边。
photographs.noteEn: Double white lines follow the bend closely as water spreads across the other side. The road reaches an edge and briefly divides two fields of colour.
photographs.decisionReason: 第二章转到平缓水边：弯路与色面关系强；不猜测粉色形成机制与湖名。

photographs.name: DSC08884
photographs.title: 崖缘的四个人
photographs.description: 四个人背向相机坐在近处岩缘上，远处是层层展开的红褐色峡谷与蓝色天空。
photographs.descriptionEn: Four people sit with their backs to the camera on a nearby rock edge, facing layered reddish-brown canyons beneath a blue sky.
photographs.alt: 四个人背向相机坐在近处岩缘上，远处是层层展开的红褐色峡谷与蓝色天空。
photographs.altEn: Four people sit with their backs to the camera on a nearby rock edge, facing layered reddish-brown canyons beneath a blue sky.
photographs.note: 四个身影占据近处一段岩面，远方的断层和曲线则继续伸展开来。经过两段道路后，身体在这里暂时停住。
photographs.noteEn: Four figures occupy a small stretch of rock nearby as distant faces and curves continue to unfold. After the roads, the body pauses here.
photographs.decisionReason: 第二章结束：人在巨大地貌前停下；人物组已确认让出。不另收长椅 DSC07933 同类观景姿态。

photographs.name: DSC02715
photographs.title: 雾里的山与船
photographs.description: 深色岩山从水面升起，近处一艘白色船留下细小航迹，后方山体在灰色雾中层层淡去。
photographs.descriptionEn: Dark rocky hills rise from water, with a white boat leaving a fine wake nearby and farther hills fading into grey mist.
photographs.alt: 深色岩山从水面升起，近处一艘白色船留下细小航迹，后方山体在灰色雾中层层淡去。
photographs.altEn: Dark rocky hills rise from water, with a white boat leaving a fine wake nearby and farther hills fading into grey mist.
photographs.note: 岩山仍有重量，远处的轮廓却逐渐隐去。船在下方留下一道很细的横线，把一段距离重新显出来。
photographs.noteEn: The hills retain their weight even as distant outlines disappear. A fine line left by the boat makes one stretch of distance visible again.
photographs.decisionReason: 结尾核心：由稠密表面转入大面积雾，不与同组 02631/02672/02713/02748 重复。

photographs.title: 洞口与积水
photographs.description: 岩洞的暗色洞壁环绕着明亮海面，洞口右侧有一名人物，下方积水反射天空与岩石。
photographs.descriptionEn: Dark cave walls frame the bright sea, with a person beside the opening and a pool below reflecting sky and rock.
photographs.alt: 岩洞的暗色洞壁环绕着明亮海面，洞口右侧有一名人物，下方积水反射天空与岩石。
photographs.altEn: Dark cave walls frame the bright sea, with a person beside the opening and a pool below reflecting sky and rock.
photographs.note: 一个洞口把海面框在中间，另一片蓝色留在脚边的积水里。右侧的人很小，岩石却从四面围拢过来。
photographs.noteEn: The opening frames the sea while another blue surface remains in the pool below. The small figure at the right makes the enclosing rock appear larger still.
photographs.decisionReason: 核心候选：框景、反射和人物不是同一层关系，可以成为段落中枢。
photographs.name: DSC07201

photographs.title: 沙面上的枝根
photographs.description: 一段浅灰色漂木横卧在白色沙面上，枝根向两边伸展，远处是低矮山影、水面和云。
photographs.descriptionEn: Pale driftwood lies across white sand, its branches extending sideways against distant hills, water and clouds.
photographs.alt: 一段浅灰色漂木横卧在白色沙面上，枝根向两边伸展，远处是低矮山影、水面和云。
photographs.altEn: Pale driftwood lies across white sand, its branches extending sideways against distant hills, water and clouds.
photographs.note: 枝根在沙面上抬起一道不规则的轮廓，与远处较平缓的山线相接。水和天空暂时退到后面，重量落在这段木头上。
photographs.noteEn: The branches raise an uneven outline above the sand, meeting the gentler line of distant hills. Water and sky recede, leaving the weight of the photograph with the wood.
photographs.decisionReason: 核心候选：由大水域收束到具体遗留物，给予节奏停顿。
photographs.name: IMG_20240430_172300

photographs.title: 泡沫的边缘
photographs.description: 蓝绿色海水中的白色泡沫铺向棕黄色沙面，浪边在画面下方形成弯曲轮廓。
photographs.descriptionEn: White foam in blue-green water spreads over ochre sand, forming a curved edge near the bottom of the frame.
photographs.alt: 蓝绿色海水中的白色泡沫铺向棕黄色沙面，浪边在画面下方形成弯曲轮廓。
photographs.altEn: White foam in blue-green water spreads over ochre sand, forming a curved edge near the bottom of the frame.
photographs.note: 水和沙之间不是一条笔直分界。泡沫在近处展开，前一道浪留下的湿沙仍然可见。
photographs.noteEn: Water and sand do not meet along a straight boundary. Foam spreads through the foreground, with wet sand still visible behind it.
photographs.decisionReason: 核心候选：近观边界，能与俯瞰海岸形成有内容的距离变化。
photographs.name: DSC06869

photographs.title: 斜向的浪
photographs.description: 高处俯看的海浪沿斜线抵达沙滩，绿色海水和浅色沙面之间散布着细小的人影。
photographs.descriptionEn: Seen from above, diagonal waves reach a sandy beach, with tiny figures scattered between green water and pale sand.
photographs.alt: 高处俯看的海浪沿斜线抵达沙滩，绿色海水和浅色沙面之间散布着细小的人影。
photographs.altEn: Seen from above, diagonal waves reach a sandy beach, with tiny figures scattered between green water and pale sand.
photographs.note: 数道白色浪沿相近的方向展开，人在沙面上变成小点。海岸在这里有宽度，浪经过的范围也进入了画面。
photographs.noteEn: Several white waves follow a shared direction, while people become small points on the sand. The shore has width here, including the stretch across which the water moves.
photographs.decisionReason: 核心候选：浪和人物同时作为比例尺，不只壮观海岸全景。
photographs.name: DSC08975
DSC04912
photographs.title: 岩面上的石阶
photographs.description: 绿色植物覆盖着岩面，几段灰色石阶沿坡折返，上方平台有几名细小人物，近处树叶略微虚化。
photographs.descriptionEn: Green vegetation covers rock as grey steps turn across the slope, with small figures on an upper platform and softly blurred leaves nearby.
photographs.note: 一段石阶藏进绿色里，又在较低处重新显出来。上方几个人很小，岩面和植物共同围住了这条折返的路。
photographs.noteEn: A stretch of steps disappears into green and emerges lower down. Small figures above give scale to the route, enclosed by both rock and plants.
photographs.decisionReason: 岩面石阶与小人物，较尖石沙地更能把自然地表与身体之间的路径联系起来；同地区 DSC04899 类似岩面不重复选。
photographs.alt: 绿色植物覆盖着岩面，几段灰色石阶沿坡折返，上方平台有几名细小人物，近处树叶略微虚化。
photographs.altEn: Green vegetation covers rock as grey steps turn across the slope, with small figures on an upper platform and softly blurred leaves nearby.

photographs.name: DSC03883
photographs.title: 黄墙下
photographs.description: 一排磨损的紫红色座椅靠着黄色墙面，上方有壁扇和向左的指示牌。
photographs.descriptionEn: A row of worn burgundy seats stands against a yellow wall beneath a wall fan and a left-pointing sign.
photographs.note: 椅背在墙下排出一道低的边。指示牌指向左侧，壁扇留在右上方，两者之间是大片没有人物的黄色。
photographs.noteEn: The seat backs form a low edge beneath the wall. A sign points left and a wall fan remains above to the right, with an expanse of unpeopled yellow between them.

photographs.name: DSC05726
photographs.title: 窗前的高椅
photographs.description: 淡蓝色舱室里，一把紫色软垫木椅面向一排明亮的窗。
photographs.titleEn: A Tall Chair by the Windows
photographs.descriptionEn: A wooden chair with purple upholstery faces a row of bright windows inside a pale blue cabin.
photographs.note: 椅子的高度把一个没有出现的人带到窗前。窗外的亮处没有给出清楚的风景，舱内的线条和这把椅子因此更近。
photographs.noteEn: The height of the chair places an unseen person at the windows. The brightness outside reveals little of the view, bringing the cabin's lines and the chair closer.

photographs.name: IMG_20250707_152207
photographs.title: 幕布前
photographs.description: 一间空的放映室里，红色座椅朝向绿色幕布，两侧为蓝色门板。
photographs.descriptionEn: Rows of red seats face a green curtain in an empty screening room, with blue door panels on either side.
photographs.note: 座椅的弧线一排排收向幕布，前排的深色椅背停在近处。人可以坐在哪里，已经由这些空位写进画面。
photographs.noteEn: Curves of seats narrow towards the curtain, while the dark backs of the front row remain close. These unoccupied places already mark where a person might sit.

photographs.name: DSC03600
photographs.title: 桌上
photographs.description: 靠窗桌面上放着冰饮、眼镜、一盘点心、餐具和一页建筑图像。
photographs.descriptionEn: An iced drink, glasses, a plate of pastries, cutlery and a printed image of a building lie on a table by a window.
photographs.note: 杯与盘围出两个圆，餐具沿着盘边延伸。眼镜和一页图像把位置缩到手边，使用这些物件的人留在画外。
photographs.noteEn: The cup and plate establish two circles, with cutlery extending along the plate's edge. Glasses and an image bring the place within reach; their user remains outside the frame.

photographs.name: DSC07680
photographs.title: 草地上的空座
photographs.description: 绿色草地上，一架白色木秋千和一张小木椅面向远处的树木与山。
photographs.titleEn: An Empty Seat on the Lawn
photographs.descriptionEn: A white wooden swing and a small chair stand on green grass before distant trees and hills.
photographs.note: 秋千没有人坐，低处的横线仍然给出一个可以停留的位置。草地伸到树下，椅子周围的空处比座位大得多。
photographs.noteEn: The unoccupied swing still marks a place to stay. Grass reaches towards the trees; the open space around the seat is much larger than the seat itself.

photographs.name: DSC05838
photographs.title: 顶上的方格
photographs.description: 发亮的方格天窗覆盖一处室内转角，下方有浅色栏杆和深色门。
photographs.descriptionEn: A luminous grid of roof lights spans an interior corner above a pale railing and dark doors.
photographs.note: 最亮的地方在头顶。栏杆绕过一个空处，两扇深色门收住墙面，天光让这段没有人物的空间有了清楚的层次。
photographs.noteEn: The brightest area is overhead. A railing turns around an opening and two dark doors hold the walls in place; light gives this unpeopled space distinct layers.

photographs.name: DSC09599
photographs.title: 中庭
photographs.description: 白色中庭内，银灰色立柱、玻璃栏杆与多层走廊交错，天窗阴影斜落在墙面。
photographs.descriptionEn: Silver-grey columns, glass railings and layered walkways cross a white atrium, with roof-light shadows falling diagonally on the walls.
photographs.note: 梁柱先划出空间，天窗的影子又覆上一层线条。下层的几个人很小，楼层之间的距离因此显出来。
photographs.noteEn: Beams and columns mark out the space, overlaid by another set of lines from the roof lights. A few small figures below make the distance between floors visible.

photographs.name: DSC07130
photographs.title: 扶梯旁
photographs.description: 从扶梯旁望向多层中庭，斜向栏杆穿过前景，白色立像与圆柱立在上方。
photographs.descriptionEn: An escalator rail crosses the foreground of a layered atrium, with a white statue and columns above.
photographs.note: 扶梯的斜线接到楼层的横线，立像停在两者之间。栏杆与柱子把这片装饰繁复的室内分成几段距离。
photographs.noteEn: The escalator's diagonal meets the horizontal lines of the floors, with a statue between them. Railings and columns divide this ornate interior into layers of distance.

photographs.name: DSC09103
photographs.title: 梁下的轨道
photographs.description: 车站钢架顶棚下，站台与铁轨朝远处收拢，亮色楼宇出现在开口外。
photographs.descriptionEn: Platforms and tracks converge beneath a station's steel roof, with light-coloured buildings beyond its opening.
photographs.note: 横梁反复截住目光，铁轨却把它送到更远的地方。顶棚下的暗处与楼宇间的亮处，将前后距离分开。
photographs.noteEn: Crossbeams repeatedly interrupt the view, while the tracks send it further away. Shadow beneath the roof and brightness between the buildings separate the distances.

photographs.name: DSC00390
photographs.title: 出口
photographs.description: 绿色金属栏杆后，一块磨损的紧急出口指示牌朝向右侧，背景是浅蓝色天空。
photographs.descriptionEn: A worn emergency-exit sign points right behind a green metal fence against a pale blue sky.
photographs.note: 箭头指向右侧，栏杆立在眼前。出口的方向越出画面，可走的路线还没有显露。
photographs.noteEn: The arrow points right while bars stand in the foreground. The direction of the exit leaves the frame; the route itself remains unseen.

photographs.name: DSC02286
photographs.title: 桥的下方
photographs.description: 蓝色天空和水面之间，悬索桥的桥塔、缆索与斜向桥面横过画面。
photographs.descriptionEn: A suspension bridge's tower, cables and diagonal deck cross the frame between blue sky and water.
photographs.note: 桥塔立直，缆索下弯，桥面沿着斜线伸向画外。下方留给水与空气的空间，也由这些线条显出来。
photographs.noteEn: The tower stands upright, the cables dip and the deck extends diagonally out of the frame. These lines also reveal the space left beneath for water and air.

photographs.name: DSC08500
photographs.title: 屋顶与云
photographs.description: 深色折线屋顶上方，一朵小白云出现在蓝色天空中央。
photographs.descriptionEn: A small white cloud sits in the blue sky above a dark roof with angular edges.
photographs.note: 屋顶没有占满画面，只留下一道重的边。云在这道边的上方，两个形状之间的蓝色空处变得很大。
photographs.noteEn: The roof leaves a heavy edge without filling the frame. A cloud hangs above it, making the blue interval between the two shapes feel expansive.

photographs.name: IMG_20240609_182826
photographs.title: 手鼓圈
photographs.description: 上海露天市集中，人们围成手鼓圈，中心演奏者举起一只手臂，观众中有人举着手机。
photographs.descriptionEn: At an outdoor market in Shanghai, people form a drum circle; the central performer raises an arm as some onlookers hold up phones.
photographs.note: 鼓面、手和目光围成一个不完全闭合的圆。有人演奏，有人拍摄，也有人停在外圈，画面让加入与旁观同时可见。
photographs.noteEn: Drumheads, hands and gazes form an incomplete circle. Some play, some record and some remain at the edge, making participation and observation visible together.

photographs.name: IMG_20240315_112511
photographs.title: 门后的弓
photographs.description: 南京一处门内，谱架旁露出拉弦乐器演奏者持弓的手与鞋，身体被门板遮住。
photographs.descriptionEn: Inside a doorway in Nanjing, a musician's bow hand and shoes appear beside a music stand while the door conceals the body.
photographs.note: 门遮住了演奏者，动作却从门边露出来。乐谱、手和鞋分占不同高度，留下一段没有完整人物的演奏。
photographs.noteEn: The door hides the musician, yet an action emerges around its edge. A score, a hand and shoes occupy separate heights, leaving a performance without a fully visible figure.

photographs.name: DSC06647
photographs.title: 墙前
photographs.description: 涂鸦墙前，一名戴护具的人持长杆滚筒刷涂刷墙面，并转头看向镜头。
photographs.descriptionEn: A person wearing protective gear holds a long-handled paint roller against a graffiti-covered wall and turns towards the camera.
photographs.note: 长杆从手里伸向墙面，回转的头又把注意力带到画面外。一个尚未结束的动作被分成了两个方向。
photographs.noteEn: The pole extends from a hand towards the wall, while a turned head draws attention beyond the frame. An unfinished action points in two directions.

photographs.name: DSC05639
photographs.title: 翻炒
photographs.description: 潮州摊前，一名黑衣人用铲子翻炒大平锅里的食物，身后有人拿着手机。
photographs.descriptionEn: At a stall in Chaozhou, a person in black turns food in a large shallow pan with a spatula, while another holds a phone behind.
photographs.note: 手、铲子与锅沿形成一条连续的线，蒸汽从左边升起。后方举着的手机又把眼前动作纳入另一个小框。
photographs.noteEn: A hand, a spatula and the pan edge form a continuous line as steam rises at the left. A raised phone behind brings the action into another small frame.

photographs.name: IMG_20240316_210659
photographs.title: 糖画摊
photographs.description: 南京窄巷里，一名戴帽的人坐在小锅旁，桌侧插着包在塑料里的糖画，巷上悬着鱼形装饰。
photographs.descriptionEn: In a narrow lane in Nanjing, a person in a hat sits beside a small pan, with wrapped sugar figures by the table and fish-shaped decorations overhead.
photographs.note: 举起的手停在锅上方，透明包装和鱼形装饰分列两边。小桌把巷道里的一件事集中到很窄的空间。
photographs.noteEn: A raised hand pauses over the pan, with clear wrapping and fish-shaped decorations on either side. A small table concentrates an activity into a narrow space within the lane.

photographs.name: DSC08392
photographs.title: 掌心
photographs.description: 一名孩子俯身伸出放着食物的手掌，一只袋鼠低头靠近。
photographs.descriptionEn: A child bends forward with food in an open palm as a kangaroo lowers its head towards the hand.
photographs.note: 两张脸向下靠近，距离在掌心处缩短。食物很小，动作却把大半个画面带到一起。
photographs.noteEn: Two faces lean down towards one another, closing the distance at an open palm. The food is small, but the gesture gathers much of the picture around it.

photographs.name: DSC02946
photographs.title: 双桨
photographs.description: 岩洞下，一名戴帽的人站在载有乘客的木船上，双手握着两支长桨；旁边有划艇与另一条船。
photographs.descriptionEn: Beneath a rocky overhang, a person in a hat stands on a wooden passenger boat holding two long oars, with kayaks and another boat nearby.
photographs.note: 两支桨从手里向两侧张开，身体立在船的中线上。前景的人影遮住一部分水面，划船的动作却让两边空间连了起来。
photographs.noteEn: Two oars open out from the hands as the body stands on the boat’s central line. Foreground silhouettes cover part of the water, but the rowing action joins the space on either side.

photographs.name: DSC06568
photographs.title: 阅览桌
photographs.description: 澳大利亚一处阅览室内，人们坐在绿色桌灯与黄色灯带照亮的长桌旁。
photographs.descriptionEn: People sit at long reading tables lit by green desk lamps and bands of yellow light in Australia.
photographs.note: 桌沿横斜穿过画面，手边的书、屏幕和灯各占一小块空间。人们相邻而坐，注意力并不朝向同一处。
photographs.noteEn: Table edges run diagonally across the frame. Books, screens and lamps occupy small spaces within reach. People sit beside one another without directing their attention to the same place.

photographs.name: DSC08679_1
photographs.title: 坡面两侧
photographs.description: 上海一处滑板现场，一名滑板者经过黄色坡面；观众聚在前景与坡缘，坡缘有人持滑板、有人拿话筒。
photographs.descriptionEn: At a skateboarding event in Shanghai, a skateboarder crosses a yellow ramp, with onlookers in the foreground and along the rim; some hold boards and one holds a microphone.
photographs.note: 滑板者被前后两排人包围，坡缘的手势、举板与遮阳动作各自延续。黄色坡面把正在行动的人和暂时停下的人分开。
photographs.noteEn: The skateboarder is surrounded by two rows of people. Gestures at the rim, held boards and a hand shielding the sun continue in different ways. The yellow ramp separates a moving figure from those who pause.

photographs.name: IMG_20240405_221505
photographs.title: 话筒前
photographs.description: 上海一处露天场地，两名演奏者站在话筒前，其中一人持吉他，周围观众有人拍手。
photographs.descriptionEn: Two performers stand at microphones in an outdoor setting in Shanghai, one holding a guitar, with some onlookers clapping.
photographs.note: 吉他手的手指、另一人的手势与后方拍手的观众落在相近的高度。一个动作从中心传到周边，仍保留着各自的姿势。
photographs.noteEn: The guitarist's fingers, the other performer's gesture and clapping hands behind occupy similar heights. Action reaches from the centre towards the edges while retaining distinct poses.

photographs.name: DSC04566
photographs.title: 廊中
photographs.description: 绍兴木廊中，一名白衣人双手握着长管乐器吹奏；层叠的栏杆与门框围住人物。
photographs.descriptionEn: A person in a white top plays a long wind instrument in a wooden corridor in Shaoxing, framed by layered railings and doorways.
photographs.note: 人物落在几层栏杆和门框之间，手指沿细长乐器排列。周围建筑占了大半画面，动作仍在中间保持清晰。
photographs.noteEn: The figure appears between layers of railings and doorways, fingers lining a slender instrument. Architecture fills much of the frame, yet the action stays legible at its centre.

photographs.name: DSC04090
photographs.title: 共用一簇火
photographs.description: 黑暗中，几只手把仙女棒靠近同一团火花，右侧一只手握着绿色打火机。
photographs.descriptionEn: In the dark, several hands bring sparklers towards a shared burst of sparks; a hand at the right holds a green lighter.
photographs.note: 人物退到画面之外，只留下手彼此靠近。火花成为一个小中心，将不同方向伸来的细杆短暂接在一起。
photographs.noteEn: The people fall beyond the frame, leaving hands approaching one another. Sparks form a small centre that briefly joins thin rods extended from different directions.
